backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all backend data types, stable state (comment lists, app events, chat messages, images, settings, prices, withdrawals), and includes storage/authorization mixins for the ICP canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (comment list creation, app event recording, access key setting, music upload) to their relevant frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, hook, and view in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light (`:root`) and dark (`.dark`) color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'App Content & Feedback Manager' that mounts the React app at `#root` via `src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the app shell with a sticky header (logo, theme toggle, music toggle), a countdown-to-midnight banner, and tab navigation between Comment, Live, Upload, and Admin views.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Password gate component for the admin panel that checks localStorage for a stored admin code and uses the `useAdminAuth` hook to unlock access, displaying a shield icon and error feedback.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: A React component that lets users select a comment list and generate multiple comments in bulk, with an optional access key gate and a copy-all feature.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: An SVG donut chart component that visually displays the ratio of used templates to total templates using a circular progress arc.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input, shoots at enemies by clicking, and tracks score and survival time.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that allows users to type and submit a comment via the addChatMessage mutation, showing loading, success, and error states.
A modal dialog that collects a 10-digit wallet number from a user and submits a withdrawal request for their total earnings, showing a success state on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using the user's Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: A hook that manages admin authentication state using a hardcoded code, persisting the unlocked status in localStorage and providing unlock and lock functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: A hook that manages an HTML Audio element for background music, supporting play/pause control based on a provided URL and enabled flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useClaimedComments.ts: A hook that stores and retrieves per-device, per-list claimed comments in localStorage, providing helpers to get, store, and check claimed comment state.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides a hook with `generate` and `generateBulk` functions that randomly pick templates from a `CommentList`, optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to midnight, updating every second via `setInterval`.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: Retrieves or generates a persistent UUID device ID stored in `localStorage`, returning it as a stable string.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for CRUD operations on comment lists, app events, settings, prices, and other backend entities using the actor from `useActor`.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global CSS custom properties for dark and light themes (colors, backgrounds, countdown banner styles) and applies base Tailwind directives with custom font families.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/utils/liveListParser.ts: Parses a structured text report into an array of `ParsedAppEntry` objects by detecting date lines, asterisk-wrapped app names, and numbered username lines.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Generates randomized app review comment templates by combining tone-specific adjectives and phrase banks across categories (performance, UI, features, support) with configurable length suffixes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those values using sessionStorage.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: Admin view that locally generates comment templates based on a topic, tone, and count using predefined phrase patterns, then allows selecting and bulk-adding them to a comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: Admin chat view that displays all stored chat messages in reverse chronological order and provides a text input to send new messages via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin view for managing comment lists, allowing creation of new lists with templates and suffix, and displaying per-list usage metrics via a donut chart.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminEarnings.t: Admin view that displays auto-calculated earnings from app events and a price list, showing summary cards and a per-app breakdown table.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin view for uploading and managing images, supporting file selection with preview, name/tag input, and displaying all stored images.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin view for managing app events (live lists), supporting manual creation with usernames and bulk auto-import by parsing a live list report format.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPricing.ts: Admin view for managing per-app price entries, supporting individual add/edit/delete and bulk CSV-style upload with active/inactive status.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings panel component that allows managing the access key (set/regenerate) and uploading background music files, with feedback states and progress tracking.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel view that handles authentication gating via AdminUnlock, then renders a tabbed navigation across all admin sub-views (comments, live list, pricing, earnings, withdrawals, AI templates, images, chat, settings).
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminWithdrawal: Admin view for displaying all user withdrawal requests, grouped by status (pending, approved, rejected) with summary stats and a refreshable list.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: React view providing single and bulk username lookup tools that check whether usernames appear in app event lists, displaying match positions and estimated earnings based on a price map.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: Admin upload view that supports bulk comment template uploads to a selected list and image uploads with name/tag metadata, using mutation hooks and inline success/error feedback.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: End-user view for selecting a comment list, optionally verifying an access key, generating a unique comment, and copying it to the clipboard, with per-device claim persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Rajdhani), OKLCH/HSL color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations; includes animate, typography, and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the current fix request: four missing Motoko backend methods (create list, app event, set access key, upload music) need to be added so the admin panel no longer returns 'backend does not support' errors.
